title: Operational state (data/picks, data/health_state) had no off-box copy: box disk only, no backup until restic (4/11–7/10)
tier_reason: loss of recoverability had it fired: the box disk held the only copy of decisions, contest ledger, delivery ids, skip-shadow markers, the non-inferable manual saver flag and health state; unfixed residuals (data/validation/ in no backup set; backup_freshness silent when backups are not armed) can still change recoverability (B → A)

contract.text: Operational state the service cannot re-derive (data/picks incl. decision records and the manual saver flag, data/health_state) has an encrypted, versioned off-box backup with a verified restore path.
contract.source: docs/audit/2026-07-09-gpt56-sol-audit.md F5 (smallest safe fix); commit 78c424a body; ARCHITECTURE.md 'Operational-state backup (audit F5, 2026-07-10)' (74d0d20)

mechanism.text: data/picks and data/health_state are gitignored, the 3am R2 artifact sync uploads only the processed PA parquets, the probable-pitcher lookup and the policy npz, and no cron job backed up either directory, so the box disk held the only copy (provider snapshots unverified)

residual.text: data/validation/ is in no backup set (live-forward official and research roots, shadow status, the W1.1 ledger build directory); the 9/28 W0.7 snapshot froze it once, but nothing backs it up going forward
backup_freshness returns no finding when backup_status.json is absent ('not armed — silent by design'), so a box whose backups were never armed, or whose status file was lost, reports healthy
The backup passes --exclude '*.lock', which also drops uv.lock files inside backed-up trees (operators store copies as uv.lock.pinned)
Hetzner provider snapshots/backups were flagged unverified (console check) and no later verification is on record in the repo

watchdog.trigger: an external cron check (independent of the scheduler) finds a directory the service writes and cannot re-derive (data/picks, data/health_state, research roots under data/validation) outside every backup set, or no successful snapshot of its set within the freshness window (ops 7 h), or no backup_status.json on the production box
watchdog.recovery_assertion: a restore-drill of the last successful ops snapshot into an empty directory brings back the saver flag and decision provenance (the 78c424a restore-drill claims), with the snapshot id recorded

evidence.locator: docs/audit/2026-07-09-gpt56-sol-audit.md F5 (read-only box inspection on 2026-07-09; command output not in the repo)
evidence.what: the R2 sync excludes data/picks entirely and no box-level backup exists (`find` for backup/restic/borg/snapshot = 0); box loss = irrecoverable operational state; Hetzner provider snapshots unverified

data/picks (decisions, contest ledger, manual saver flag, skip-shadow markers) and data/health_state existed only on the box: gitignored, excluded from the R2 artifact sync, no provider snapshot; the saver flag is deliberately not inferable; adds restic ops/archive sets, restore-drill and backup_freshness (silent when the status file is absent)
sync_to_r2 uploads data/processed/pa_*.parquet, probable_pitcher_lookup.json and mdp_policy.npz only; the cron script has no backup job; data/picks/ and data/health_state/ are gitignored
2b752be (same sync scope, no backup job) deployed 2026-06-07T00:11:21Z, canary passed: the pre-fix configuration was installed inside the window
pre-deploy 49f2538 -> deployed 6919e19 at 2026-07-10T18:41:02Z, canary passed: the restic backup code (78c424a, 16ff24d) was first installed
backup cron lines ops `20 */3`, archive `50 4`, prune `35 5 Sun`; restore runbook in INCIDENT.md; 'first live drill at deploy time' — no activation time recorded

evidence.locator: CLAUDE.md 'restic (bts backup)' (d7c64b1); src/bts/data/backup.py BACKUP_SETS and src/bts/health/backup_freshness.py at 9907cb9
evidence.what: ops = data/picks + data/health_state, archive = data/leaderboard + data/hetzner_results + data/external: data/validation/ is in no set; --exclude '*.lock'; an absent status file is silent

notes: no evidenced firing (no box loss); exposure interval 2026-04-11 (Hetzner cutover, 51ef987) → the first successful ops snapshot, whose time is not in the repo (code live 2026-07-10T18:41:02Z; activation needs restic install, RESTIC_PASSWORD and a crontab install that no deploy performs) — B2 restic snapshot list (ids/times/tags, Phase 2) would bound it

fix set: 78c424a + 16ff24d are the backup-only commits (both first live in 6919e19); review rounds ea73b78, 6d74d39 (live 2026-07-10T19:49:38Z) and 30452eb (live 2026-07-13T01:12:47Z via 230f65c) also touched the backup code — hence complete_fix_set false
